Where can I find your full shipping policy?
Here are the key details of our shipping policy:
Where We Ship: We offer free shipping across all 10 Canadian provinces, every US state except Hawaii, Alaska, and the US Virgin Islands, and select areas in Australia (New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, and parts of the Australian Capital Territory). We do not ship to the Northern Territory, Western Australia, or Tasmania, nor outside Canada, the US, and Australia.
Cost: Standard shipping is free with no minimum purchase required. In rare cases, customers in remote areas may incur additional shipping fees, which are automatically calculated and clearly displayed at checkout based on location, weight, dimensions, and box count.
Delivery Method: Standard delivery is doorstep or lobby service via third-party couriers. Packages are left at the front door of a house or in the lobby of an apartment/condo on weekdays (excluding statutory holidays). Couriers do not bring packages to unit doors, assist with assembly, or remove old furniture.
Assembly Options: White Glove Delivery (including room-of-choice delivery, full assembly, and packaging removal) is available in limited regions and confirmed at checkout.
Timelines: Estimated delivery dates depend on stock availability and can be seen near the "Add to Cart" button on each product page or in your Cozey account.

What's your return and refund policy?
Here is how our return and refund policy works:
30-Day Risk-Free Trial: All Cozey items, including rugs, come with a 30-day risk-free trial starting from the day you receive them (mattresses have a 100-night trial). If an item isn't the right fit for your space, you can return it free of charge.
Packaging Requirements & Fees: Returns are completely free as long as items are returned in their original packaging. If original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) is deducted from your refund. (Note: original packaging does not need to be kept for mattress returns).
How to Initiate: You can start a return online through our Self-Service Portal. Once submitted, prepaid return labels and packing instructions are emailed to you.
Inspection & Refund Processing: Once your returned items arrive at our warehouse, our Quality Assurance Team inspects them to ensure there are no customer-caused damages or modifications. After inspection, please allow 3–7 business days for your refund to be processed.
CozeyProtection+: If you purchased CozeyProtection+, you will receive a refund for the coverage if you return the entire product within the eligible return period. Partial returns are not eligible for partial refunds of the protection plan.
